info.name: Markdown Wiki
info.summary: Turn your Markdown files into a powerful wiki inside Nextcloud
info.description:
Markdown Wiki transforms your Markdown files into an organized and easy-to-navigate wiki directly inside Nextcloud.
Browse your Markdown files through a folder-based navigation tree, edit pages directly in the app, navigate between documents using breadcrumbs and previous/next controls, and quickly find content with full-text search.
Markdown Wiki also provides automatic table of contents generation, Mermaid diagram support, and seamless integration with Nextcloud Files and its light and dark themes.
Your wiki remains based on standard Markdown files stored in Nextcloud, keeping your content portable and accessible without locking it into a proprietary format.
info.author: João Sacramento
